hero.cta: Primary gold button leading to product catalog

elements: Add to Cart CTA (Outline or Primary)

cart_drawer.whatsapp_logic: Generate a text string of cart items and redirect to wa.me/919876543210?text=urlencoded_string

store_experience.style: Large immersive photography with minimal text overlay, bento grid layout for interior shots

sweets_category.description: Close-up of traditional Indian sweet Gulab Jamun on black background.

generic_product.description: Assortment of chocolates/sweets on dark fabric.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure gold text (#D4AF37) against dark backgrounds (#0A0A0A) meets minimum 4.5:1 WCAG AA ratio. Use #FAFAFA for long form body text.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, links, selects, form inputs, cart triggers) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='whatsapp-checkout-btn', data-testid='add-to-cart-gulab-jamun').

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark Luxury Archetype. The background MUST be pure black (#0A0A0A) or near-black (#111111).
Use 'Cormorant Garamond' for all headings and 'Outfit' for body text. Do NOT use Inter for headings.
The primary brand color is Gold (#D4AF37). Use it sparingly for text highlights, borders, and primary CTAs.
Do NOT use standard white background Shadcn cards. Override all Shadcn components (Cards, Inputs, Drawers) to have #111111 backgrounds and gold/10 borders.
Implement a slide-over Cart drawer. The final checkout button MUST redirect to WhatsApp using the provided wa.me link structure, containing the cart items details.
Ensure the hero section uses the provided hero background image with a proper dark overlay so the gold text is fully readable.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons configured with thin/light strokes to match the luxury aesthetic.
Include data-testid on all key interactive elements.
